svg.title: Three Layers and Nesting options compared in plan and section
svg.desc: Proposed bubble relationships, not measured plans. South pedestrian entrance and east ramp to underground parking are constant. Every option pairs a ground diagram with above-ground and B1 sectional relationships.

g.text: One story. Three ways to nest the layers.
South: pedestrians from C1. East: ramp to underground parking, then lift / stairs to the lobby.
